descriptions.pipeshub_sources: Lists the connectors and collections the user can read, and the AI models set up for the workspace. Clients use it to choose where to search and which model to chat with.
descriptions.pipeshub_search: Searches indexed documents by meaning across the connectors and collections the user can read, and returns the matching passages with their records.
descriptions.pipeshub_get_record_content: Reads the full text of one record. It also finds a record from a URL, issue key or external ID, browses what sits under a folder, space or epic, and reads a whole Slack thread.
descriptions.pipeshub_download_record: Downloads the original file stored for a record, optionally converted to PDF.
descriptions.pipeshub_directory: Looks up the signed-in user, the workspace's users, and the teams the user belongs to. It changes nothing.
descriptions.pipeshub_create_collection: Creates a new, empty collection owned by the user, ready for uploads.
descriptions.pipeshub_upload: Uploads documents into a collection so they are indexed and become searchable. Up to 20 documents and about 3 MB per call.
descriptions.pipeshub_indexing_status: Reports how far a collection's indexing has got, and which documents failed and why.
descriptions.pipeshub_connect_source: Returns a link the user opens in a browser to connect a source such as Slack, Google Drive or Jira. The tool itself connects nothing.
descriptions.pipeshub_add_web_source: Adds a website as the user's own Web connector. It crawls from a start page, follows its links, and crawls again every day. It keeps 100 pages unless the client asks for more, up to 10,000. An OAuth app or access token also needs the connector:write and connector:sync scopes.
descriptions.pipeshub_chat: Asks PipesHub's own assistant, or one of the workspace's agents, and returns its answer with citations. While write tools are off it does not run connected actions. Turning it off also turns off the agents list.
descriptions.pipeshub_agents: Lists the workspace's agents with their tools and knowledge, so a client can chat with one. It is offered only while Chat with PipesHub is on.
descriptions.pipeshub_show_citations: Shows the user the sources behind an answer, numbered [1], [2] and so on, with a preview of each document. Up to 30 passages per call. It is offered only to clients that can display the citation viewer, such as Claude.
descriptions.pipeshub_preview_record: Used only by the citation viewer, never by the AI model. It loads a record's stored file in pieces so the viewer can show the document. While it is off, the viewer cannot load document previews.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_repos: Lists the indexed code repositories the user can read. The code tools are offered only to users who have indexed code, and an OAuth app or access token also needs the code:read scope.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_symbols: Shows what a directory or file in an indexed repository holds: subdirectories and files, or the symbols a file defines.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_neighbours: Shows what surrounds a file or symbol in the code graph: its callers, the code it calls, its imports and inheritance.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_read: Reads indexed source code: one symbol, a line range or a whole file. It reads the indexed copy, which can be behind the repository.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_path: Shows how one symbol reaches another in a repository, hop by hop.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_search: Finds code by an exact name, a string or a regular expression.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_semantic_search: Finds the code behind a feature or behaviour from a plain-language description, when its names are not known.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_outline: Lists a file's classes, functions and methods with their signatures and line ranges, without the bodies.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_impact: Shows what depends on a symbol: everything that calls, imports or builds on it, with the tests that reach it. It answers who calls this and what breaks if it changes.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_impact_of_diff: Takes a unified diff, such as git diff output or the diff of a pull request, and shows the symbols it changes, the files and tests that reach them, and the callers no test covers.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_history: Lists the indexed pull requests that changed a file, with author, reviewers, who merged it and the tickets it names.
descriptions.pipeshub_code_entry_points: Lists where control enters a repository, such as routes, command-line tools, jobs and hooks. A starting point for reading unfamiliar code.
descriptions.pipeshub_entities: Finds the people, teams, topics, projects, folders, customers and document titles in the workspace's knowledge graph, lists the records connected to one of them, and the people, companies or products mentioned alongside it. Finding and listing are offered once entities have been indexed; the mentioned-alongside list also needs named-entity extraction. An OAuth app or access token also needs the semantic:read or semantic:write scope.
descriptions.pipeshub_find_records: Lists records by who they belong to or what they mention rather than by their words: the records a person is assigned, created, wrote or owns, records that mention an amount, date, quantity or percentage, and passages inside the records that name given people, companies or products. Amounts and dates need named-entity extraction, and the passages are offered only where the deployment also turns on entity search. An OAuth app or access token also needs the semantic:read or semantic:write scope.
